about: Delta is a municipality in Metro Vancouver made up of three distinct communities: suburban North Delta, the historic fishing village of Ladner, and the ferry and farmland peninsula of Tsawwassen. It sits between the Fraser River and Boundary Bay, with remaining agricultural land on the delta flats. BC Ferries sail to Vancouver Island from the Tsawwassen terminal. About 108,000 people live in Delta.
